headline: Robust earnings; ARPU growth offset muted subs addition

highlights: Enterprise business revenue rose 11.4% YoY to INR 58.8bn while EBITDA was up 1.3% QoQ/15.1% YoY at INR 25.3bn led by broad-based growth across core business and digital services portfolio.

We are marginally raising FY28–29 EBITDA estimate by ~1% factoring in H1FY27 results; TP has been revised up marginally to INR 2,410 (from INR 2,400), implying 12.9x FY28E EV/EBITDA for India business (ex-Indus) versus 11.2x implied as per CMP.

It also reported consolidated EBITDAaL of INR 315bn in Q2FY27 (up 5.5% QoQ and up 18.4% YoY); consolidated PAT was INR 88.9bn. ▪ India wireless EBITDA slightly better than JMFe/consensus at INR 189bn led by strong 2.7% QoQ rise in ARPU to INR 271, partly offset by muted subs addition: India wireless revenue was a little higher at INR 309bn (+3.4% QoQ/+10.1% YoY) versus JMFe/consensus of INR 308bn/307bn.
India wireless EBITDA was also marginally better at INR 189bn (+3.8% QoQ/+11.3% YoY) versus JMFe/consensus of INR 188bn/187bn; India wireless EBITDA margin improved to 61.0% (60.8% in Q1).
valuation: We are marginally raising FY28–29 EBITDA estimate by ~1% factoring in H1FY27 results; TP has been revised up marginally to INR 2,410 (from INR 2,400), implying 12.9x FY28E EV/EBITDA for India business (ex-Indus) versus 11.2x implied as per CMP.
We reiterate BUY as we believe the industry’s wireless ARPU is likely to grow at ~12% CAGR over FY26–29, driven by regular tariff hike and multiple premiumisation strategies.
Exhibit 11: At CMP, Bharti’s India business is trading at 11.2x FY28 EV/EBITDA vs implied 12.9x implied in our TP Source: Company, JM Financial.
